create_placeholder_instance: create a Placeholder instance from an OmegaConf DictConfig with placeholder settings
get_placeholder_width: get the width property of a Placeholder from its config
get_placeholder_height: get the height property of a Placeholder from its config
plot_placeholder_on_axes: plot a Placeholder as a rounded black rectangle on a matplotlib axes
plot_placeholder_new_figure: plot a Placeholder on a new matplotlib figure and return the figure and axes
